name: Hamburger Pie
description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: English Shepherd's Pie
_similar.description: A traditional shepherd's pie with ground beef, vegetables, and mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef briskly over high heat. Drain off excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and reduce heat. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the meat is well browned.
Sprinkle the flour over the meat mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Gradually add water, stock cube, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, bay leaf, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Add the can of peas to the meat mixture.
Transfer the meat mixture to a casserole dish and cover with mashed potatoes.
Bake in a 400°F oven until the top is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes

_similar.name: Turkey or Chicken Pies
_similar.description: Individual or large pies filled with turkey or chicken, vegetables, and a creamy sauce, topped with a homemade pastry crust or biscuits.
_similar.recipeYield: Multiple individual pies or 1 large pie

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine with salt and pepper over low heat. Add flour and gradually add broth, cooking until smooth.
Sauté chopped onion and celery until tender.
Boil carrots until thoroughly cooked.
Mix cooked carrots with peas and the sauce made earlier.
For the pastry, mix flour, salt, and baking powder with butter. Add milk to form a dough.
Fill small pans or a large pie plate with the turkey or chicken mixture and top with pastry crust or biscuits.
Bake until the crust is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: turkey pie, chicken pie, savory pastry, comfort food

_similar.name: Chinese Hamburger Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty, savory casserole featuring ground hamburger, rice, and vegetables, with an optional addition of bean sprouts for an authentic touch.

recipeInstructions.text: Thoroughly brown hamburger in a skillet; add the onions, celery, cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups.
Stir in the mushrooms, warm water, uncooked rice, soya sauce, pepper and salt.
Add bean sprouts if using for a more authentic taste.
Turn the ingredients into a casserole dish and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Remove cover, stir the casserole and continue baking for about 15 minutes longer.
Sprinkle chow mein noodles over casserole and bake for 15 minutes more (total baking time is 1 hour).

_similar.keywords: Chinese casserole, hamburger casserole, rice casserole

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Meatball Pasta Stew
_similar.description: A savory stew with homemade meatballs, pasta, and a rich tomato-based sauce.
recipeIngredient: ¼ to ⅛ cup dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Combine hamburger, egg, bread crumbs, onion, salt, mustard, and pepper to make meatballs. Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place meatballs on a greased baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10 to 15 minutes, or until browned.
In a large pot, cook onion and garlic until tender.
Add flour and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, stirring constantly until boiling.
Add tomato paste, undrained tomatoes, bay leaf, and thyme. Mix well.
Add meatballs, carrots, zucchini, peppers, and parsley. Simmer for 40 minutes.
Add cooked pasta and heat until hot.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

_similar.keywords: meatball stew, pasta stew, tomato-based sauce
